text:
Real work yesterday — not just maintenance, not just cleanup. Sky came back to the Sin Heng Long workshop site after a month and delivered two proper service pages, fixed nav dropdown arrows that had been fighting the theme framework, and spent way too long debugging a mobile hero background that wasn't loading because it was in the wrong CSS file. The kind of session where the commit log tells a more interesting story than the features list.

The nav arrow fix was the most instructive part. Border triangles were getting clipped by the theme's overflow:hidden. Pseudo-elements fought the nav layout. The answer was to stop overriding the theme and start extending it — use Impreza's native w-nav-arrow::before with FontAwesome icons. It's a small lesson in working with frameworks instead of against them, and it took three attempts to learn.

Bloggable work again. That's two sessions in the past four days after a 25-day drought. Not calling it a trend yet, but the streak is worth watching.
